jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technology?
Does building next generation Cloud Computing technology excites you?

Join our Compute Site Reliability team!
Our team is responsible for monitoring and measuring the reliability of our suite of Compute products and platform. In collaboration with Engineering and Product teams, we focus on improving the performance and reliability of the products we support.

Partner with the best
Apply statistical analysis and networking expertise to solve critical cloud delivery challenges. Independently maintain our massive compute fleet using system diagnostics and best practices. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to benchmark performance and drive reliability improvements.
As a Site Reliability Engineer II, you will be responsible for:

• Troubleshooting Linux networking and cloud infrastructure performance issues.

• Implementing monitoring, alerts, and SLOs using Prometheus and Grafana.

• Responding to incidents, escalating risks, and supporting root cause analysis.

• Developing automation, software tools, and infrastructure-as-code to improve reliability.

• Analyzing system metrics to improve compute fleet health and capacity.

• Partnering across teams on product goals, operations, and documentation.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 3+ years of academic or industry experience and a relevant bachelor's degree

• Have SRE or systems engineering experience with large-scale distributed systems

• Understand Linux networking, DNS, routing, and L7 proxies (Envoy, HAProxy, NGINX)

• Have experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK

• Be proficient in scripting and infrastructure automation tools (Python, Terraform, Ansible)

• Be familiar with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools

About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA
URL: https://we.are.expensify.com/

Your Mission, Should You Choose To Accept
Join our passionate team of customer experts to solve real-world problems and help people spend less time managing expenses and more time pursuing their real goals. As we revolutionize the way people manage their expenses, being part of the Expensify team means building the easiest, fastest, and most efficient platform to automate everything expense-related.

Customer Success Management at Expensify
Own a portfolio of our mid-market and enterprise customers, from onboarding through renewal and growth. You'll be the person enterprise customers trust to keep things running, and to spot the next opportunity before they've even asked. If you like turning usage data into revenue outcomes and holding your own in a C-suite conversation, this one's for you.

As a Customer Success Manager, your responsibilities include:

• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across finance, IT and operations, right up to the C-suite

• Owning the full account lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, renewal and growth

• Spotting risk and configuration issues early, and proactively solving them

• Guiding customers through migrations and product rollouts, instilling confidence in the product and your ability to support them in any software transition within their tech stack

• Turning usage data into a clear account plan that ties activity back to revenue

• Driving adoption of Expensify's core products, including expense management, global reimbursement, Expensify Card and Travel

• Troubleshooting technical issues hands-on, from accounting integrations and card feeds to SSO and API workflows, and tracing each one to its root cause

• Acting as the bridge between customers and our product and engineering teams, translating customer feedback into something they can act on

• Managing renewals, upsell and cross-sell conversations, and holding your own in contract talks

You'll be expected to:

• Improve net dollar retention across your portfolio

• Engage with your accounts every quarter

• Forecast and increase contract renewals

• Increase product adoption across your accounts

About You
We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who thinks like a product manager and acts like a trusted advisor. You've owned renewals, run QBRs and grown accounts through cross-sell and upsell. You understand how software works, and financial systems knowledge is a bonus. You're comfortable with data, not vibes, and you build account plans that tie activity back to revenue. You use AI to work smarter, but you never let it replace your own judgment. You see a problem and want to fix it, even when it isn't technically yours to fix.

Experience and Background
Required

• 3+ years of B2B SaaS account management or customer success experience, with direct ownership of a customer portfolio

• Experience owning renewals, retention, and growth, including commercial conversations around pricing, expansion, or contract terms

• Strong product and technical fluency, with experience working through APIs, integrations, or other connected software systems

• Strong data literacy, including using spreadsheets, dashboards, usage data, and reporting tools to make decisions and build a business case

• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders

• Comfort operating autonomously, setting priorities and managing competing demands without heavy day-to-day direction

Desirable

• Experience managing enterprise accounts, or a mix of mid-market and enterprise

• Experience with FinTech, payments, spend management, accounting, ERP, or other financial software

• Familiarity with tools and integrations such as NetSuite, Okta, Workday, HubSpot, GitHub, Gong, or similar platforms

• Experience using AI to automate workflows, improve processes, or solve business problems

• Experience managing global customers and working effectively across time zones and asynchronously

Compensation & Benefits:

• 401(k) with up to 4.5% employer match

• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage

• $20,000 annual fertility and family-building benefit through Carrot

• Up to $5,000 in relocation reimbursement if you move to one of our offices

• Three months of paid parental leave; six months for birthing parents

• Commuter, healthcare FSA, and dependent care FSA benefits

• Flexible vacation policy

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/expensify-customer-success-manager

jobs.title: Partner Sales Manager - Dell
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing Dell alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical . These companies build software-defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical ’s flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Alliances - Dell, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable Dell teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within Dell, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with Dell, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

The role entails

• Build strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership

• Build pipeline and transact opportunities through Dell

• Grow Dell’s awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem

• Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner

• Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person

• Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact

• Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio

• Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns as defined by the Senior Director

What we are looking for in you

• Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles

• Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality

• Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities

• Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission

• Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals

• Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills

• Credibility and working knowledge of Dell - its products, go-to-market motion, and field

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

• Hands on experience with SalesForce.com and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Embedded & Desktop Linux Systems Engineer - Optimisation
jobs.description:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

• Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks

• Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms

• Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics

• Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge

• Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server

• Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical , you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

• You love technology and working with brilliant people

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar

• You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)

• You have experience working with open source communities and licences

• You have experience working with C, C++

• You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional skills that you might also bring

• Experience with graphics stacks

• Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST

• Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments

• Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience

• IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services

• Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era.
As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents.
Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.

Cato Networks is seeking a NOC Engineer to join the team. In this critical role, you will be monitoring, supporting, and providing advanced troubleshooting of a large complex data network infrastructure by using network monitoring and management tools. You will work closely with teams from our business areas, network engineering, and management as a team representative on major incident bridges. This is a remote position based in the Philippines.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and manage the uptime, stability, and overall functionality of the company’s production systems. This includes troubleshooting and resolving system and network issues end-to-end.

• Monitor and respond to NetOps alerts during working hours, and review/follow up on alerts triggered outside business hours as required.

• Continuously track and analyze system performance to identify risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities for optimization.

• Proactively mitigate outages and system malfunctions to prevent customer impact. When necessary, prepare clear and prioritized escalations to the relevant Development teams.

• Coordinate with third-party service providers (e.g., carriers, SMS providers, IX providers, and other vendors) to resolve network and system-related issues.

• Provide advanced (higher-tier) technical support to internal Customer Support teams (T1–T3).

• Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and alerting mechanisms to ensure system visibility and operational awareness.

• Serve as a technical focal point for Customer Support and Field Engineering teams by understanding business use cases and translating them into operational requirements.

• Contribute to building, improving, and expanding NetOps ownership, processes, documentation, and operational best practices.

Role Scope

• The role is primarily driven by automated system alerts requiring investigation, troubleshooting, and escalation when necessary.

• The role also involves handling customer-impacting issues escalated by the Customer Support organization.

• In addition to reactive tasks, the position includes ongoing projects and operational initiatives to be managed during working hours.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong experience in network architecture, cloud architecture, and security architecture.

• Deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, proxy servers, and related technologies.

• Strong ability to analyze system and application logs to identify root causes of issues.

• Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex network and system incidents.

• Experience working in a Cloud or SaaS technology environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and communicate with cross-functional teams.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple concurrent projects and incidents simultaneously.

jobs.title: Product Management Intern
jobs.description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.
The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.
We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

• Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

• Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28

• Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.

• Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.

• Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

• True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.

• High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.

• Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.
Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik
At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.
Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

• Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

• Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

• Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.
Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com . Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

jobs.title: Manager, Professional Services Federal
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Joining Collibra’s Professional Services Team
At Collibra Public Sector (CPS), the Manager, Federal Professional Services is responsible for leading all services roles and functions to ensure the long-term success, adoption, and satisfaction of government clients. The role drives a cohesive customer journey, aligns services delivery with other CPS delivery to mission outcomes, and ensures operational excellence across the entire customer lifecycle. This role safeguards account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction by proactively identifying and mitigating technical risk, coordinating services engagements, and building operational frameworks for GTM clarity and alignment amongst the services teams.

Federal Engagement Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

Services Management

• Manage services operations and resources, including Engagement Manager and Solution Architects, ensuring timely and successful project execution and value delivery.

• Manages professional service team in respect to project milestones, delivery and goals.

• Responsible for team utilization and revenue optimization.

• Drive operational excellence in services delivery.

• Monitor performance to ensure teams are performing within expectations and achieving high levels of project success.

• Collaborate on GTM strategy for CPS Services, helping shape how services is positioned, sold, and delivered throughout the customer journey.

• Guide sales enablement and customer-facing messaging, ensuring services' value proposition is clear, consistent, and aligned with customer needs.

• Evaluate pricing and packaging strategies for new and existing offerings.

• Identify expansion opportunities and influence sales motions with timely insights.

• Contribute to strategic deal support, partnering with Sales and Finance on high-impact renewals, expansions, and new business that include services offerings.

• Engages with new / prospective customers to identify business challenges and opportunities, recommend solutions / solution enhancements and propose a high-level delivery roadmap based on expected business value.

Customer Project Oversight

• Guide project team members through scoping and level of effort estimates.

• Ensure effective controls are in place and regularly updated in order to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle including: project plans, status reports, time recording, resource planning, and first value forecasting.

• Advises implementation project teams and customers on milestone achievement, issue resolution and change management.

• Ensures effective controls are in place to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle.

• Develops and tracks overall project success, customer satisfaction, and quality of delivery.

• Maintains and nurtures consultative relationships with key customer leadership and decision-makers.

• Establishes and ensures effective execution of solution delivery accelerating the customer's time to value.

• Perform post-project reviews to ensure achievement of business objectives.

Customer Journey Mapping and Operational improvement

• Assist with the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end customer journey.

• Implement frameworks to continuously assess services customer value realization, using structured feedback and data to refine operational and delivery models.

• Drive maturity in delivery practices, tooling, and customer engagement models.

• Standardize and operationalize proactive engagement workflows in relation to the technical teams (e.g., onboarding, QBRs, Value delivery, and Renewal motions).

• Identify trends and opportunities for improvement within the services organization, and implement solutions to enhance customer success and team efficiency.

• Captures lessons learned and ensures their application to future project planning and process improvement.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Engagement Managers and Solution Architects, empowering them to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

• Foster a culture of accountability, high performance, and customer obsession.

• Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent with expertise in government operations.

• Cultivate an environment that fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

• Ensures timely and effective communication of departmental goals and objectives internally within the department and more broadly with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Develop and implement strategies to achieve team and individual performance goals, exceeding customer, organization and company expectations.

• Ensures that training, coaching and mentoring programs are developed, implemented and effective for the team.

Customer Risk Prevention, Assessment & Management

• Build and manage frameworks for early identification of at-risk projects or customers in relation to services engagements.

• Act as a management escalation point for the Services team encountering project obstacles, and liaise with internal teams for resolution.

• Support employees in raising issues associated with customer and project risk.

• Partner with Sales and the other technical GTM teams to identify and mitigate renewal or churn risk.

• Support proactive risk reviews for strategic/enterprise accounts.

• Manages pivotal customer issues and concerns through the team, directly handling escalated issues.

• Drive customer project At-Risk post-mortems and ensure preventive actions are implemented.

You have:

• A U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil as the role supports the U.S. government.

• 5+ years of experience in consulting supporting U.S. federal agencies.

• A minimum of 2 years of experience managing services teams in the support of U.S. federal agencies.

• Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong leadership skills collaborating with Sr Executives on a frequent basis.

• Knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.

• Have previous military experience.

• Hold an active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).

• Knowledgeable of at least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management.

• An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.

• Experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.

• An understanding of APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments.

• An understanding of data warehousing, ETL, data integration.

You are

• An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.

• Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.

• Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.

• Self-starting and interested in learning new software.

• Able to lead Senior Level customer discussions representing CPS and services engagements.

Measures of Success

• Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to

• Clearly understand the roles and responsibilities of the reporting employees and the account assignments.

• Present the services offering, understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.

• Present the Customer Journey framework, understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.

• Clearily understand the roles and responsibilities of all delivery personnel including an Engagement Manager, Solution Architect, Account Program Manager, Premium Support Engineer, Sales Engineer and Account Executive.

• Within the first 60 days of employment

• Navigate Salesforce including opportunities, utilization, projects, and quotes.

• Identify customers and services engagements at Risk and build a plan to remediate.

• Identify process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.

• Present the services offering to a customer.

• Within the first 90 days of employment be able to

• Advise Sales on proposed services engagements.

• Build Salesforce reports for visibility into Services engagements including utilization.

• Build playbooks to address process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.

• Execute remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales, support, and technical teams.

• Understand and convey to customers how Collibra's suite product capabilities and the projects being delivered provide value to customers.

Compensation for this role
The standard base salary range for this position is $128,000 - 160,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.
In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Benefits at Collibra
Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .
We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.
At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.
With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

jobs.title: Manager, CyberSecurity Risk Management
jobs.description:
About the team:
The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role:
We are looking for a Manager, CyberSecurity Risk Management to join our security risk management team and support the delivery of Rubrik's cybersecurity risk management program. Working closely with the team's lead Program Manager, who owns the program, you will help drive day-to-day execution: coordinating cross-functional risk assessments, supporting risk review and acceptance processes, tracking risk remediation to closure, and producing risk reporting that gives leadership a clear view of Rubrik's cybersecurity risk posture. You will partner with Security, Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Procurement, and Finance to keep work on track and deliver measurable outcomes. Success in this role requires strong program management discipline, solid risk and compliance knowledge, and the ability to influence and build consensus at every level of the company.

What you’ll do:

• Support program operations for the overall Cybersecurity Risk Management Program.

• Support and conduct risk assessments and triage incoming security issues related to Rubrik’s core products, services, and infrastructure.

• Draft clear risk statements that translate technical findings into business impact, including likelihood/impact rationale and key assumptions.

• Maintain and update the risk register, ensuring ownership, status, target dates, and risk treatment decisions are accurate and timely.

• Coordinate and track cross-functional risk initiatives, managing timelines, dependencies, and action items; flag delivery risks early and drive follow-through.

• Drive remediation of risks to closure by conducting periodic cross-functional check-ins with risk owners to obtain updates, track milestones and target dates, document progress in the risk register, remove/escalate blockers, and communicate status through leadership reporting.

• Support the risk governance cadence, including preparing materials for risk committee meetings, facilitating risk acceptance and exception reviews, and tracking escalations, decisions, and actions to completion.

• Collect and analyze program metrics (KPIs/KRIs), build dashboards, and help prepare risk updates for leadership.

• Support the risk assessment program at scale, including enterprise, technical, and third-party/supplier risk assessments, helping keep methodology, quality, and turnaround times consistent.

• Execute and document cybersecurity risk assessments (inherent and residual) for systems, applications, cloud services, and initiatives; gather evidence and validate control implementation with stakeholders.

• Help map program activities to compliance obligations and frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, NIST CSF/800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA) and emerging regulations (e.g., DORA, NIS2, EU AI Act).

• Contribute to risk quantification efforts so risks can be prioritized in business and financial terms.

• Support GRC tooling, automation, and AI-enabled improvement initiatives by gathering requirements, coordinating implementation tasks, piloting use cases (e.g., LLM-assisted intake triage, evidence mapping, and automated status summarization), and driving adoption of standardized workflows with appropriate governance and human review.

• Identify gaps and recommend process improvements to make risk management activities more efficient, consistent, and effective.

Experience you'll need:

• 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity risk management, or GRC, including at least 3 years in a program or project management role.

• Experience supporting or helping scale a cybersecurity risk management program in a fast-paced technology, SaaS, or cloud company.

• Strong program management skills: project planning, dependency management, effort estimation, status reporting, and delivery of cross-functional initiatives.

• Solid working knowledge of risk management methodologies (NIST RMF / 800-37 / 800-30, ISO 27005, COBIT) and common security frameworks such as ISO 27001/2, SOC 2, FedRAMP, NIST CSF / 800-53, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, and HIPAA.

• Enough technical understanding of cloud, identity, network, and application security to engage credibly with engineering teams and follow remediation plans.

• Able to communicate risk clearly to senior stakeholders and build consensus without direct authority.

• Hands-on experience with agile project management and reporting tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Tableau).

• Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Security, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Intern - Noida
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
HR – Recruitment /
Intern /
On-site
 
Location: Noida
Duration: 6 months
Working days: 5 days work from office
 
About Paytm Group: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
About the role: A Talent Acquisition (TA) Intern will support the recruitment team in sourcing and screening candidates for technology roles. The role will involve working on real-time tech hiring requirements, coordinating interviews, candidate communication, maintaining recruitment trackers, and supporting hiring drives.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
* Source and screen candidates for Tech roles through LinkedIn, Naukri and other platforms.
* Identify relevant profiles based on technical requirements and job descriptions.
* Conduct initial candidate communication and HR screening calls.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates, recruiters and hiring managers.
* Support tech hiring drives, including weekend drives, as required.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases and hiring reports.
* Support job postings, offer documentation and candidate follow-ups.
* Work closely with recruiters and stakeholders to ensure smooth hiring.
* Assist with employer branding and other TA initiatives.
 
Skills & Qualifications:
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Talent Acquisition and recruitment processes.
* Good sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Ability to understand basic technical job requirements.
* Good coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri and other sourcing platforms will be an advantage.
* Proactive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
 
What You Will Gain
Hands-on exposure to Tech Talent Acquisition and recruitment operations.
Experience working on real-time technology hiring requirements.
Exposure to sourcing, screening, HR calls and interview coordination.
Experience handling tech hiring drives and recruitment reporting.
Opportunity to interact with candidates, recruiters and business stakeholders.
Practical understanding of the end-to-end recruitment process.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
About the team:
The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role:
Rubrik is seeking a Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst to lead Commercial Audit and Certification Management. In this role, you will own Rubrik's portfolio of security certifications and coordinated audits end-to-end, from evidence collection through auditor management to final report delivery, ensuring audit readiness is continuous and audit findings are tracked to closure.

What you'll do:

• Own the audit and certification calendar across Rubrik's active portfolio: SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1 and Level 2, TISAX Level 1 and Level 2, HITRUST, HIPAA.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, managing scoping, fieldwork, evidence requests, and remediation of findings through to closure.

• Maintain the mapping between compliance controls and underlying evidence sources so audit readiness is continuous rather than a point-in-time scramble.

• Drive coordinated audit strategy, consolidating overlapping evidence requests across frameworks to reduce duplicate work for control owners.

• Lead evaluation and scoping of emerging and planned certifications to support Rubrik's international and AI governance expansion.

• Manage the lifecycle of certifications end-to-end, including retirements and transitions

• Track and report audit status, findings, and remediation progress to leadership, using the team's Jira-based tracking dashboards.

• Partner with control owners across InfoSec, IT, Legal, and Engineering to gather evidence and close audit findings on schedule.

• Collaborate with Risk Management to ensure audit findings feed into the broader risk register and remediation lifecycle (RMLC).

• Support Customer Trust Enablement by ensuring audit and certification outputs are readily usable to answer customer security inquiries.

• Leverage AI and automation to streamline evidence gathering, control testing, and audit workflows.

Experience you'll need:

• 5+ years of experience in security compliance, audit management, or GRC

• Hands-on experience managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 audits, plus at least one additional framework

• Experience working directly with external auditors and certification bodies, including scoping and negotiating audit timelines.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit cycles.

• Familiarity with GRC tooling and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) for tracking evidence and remediation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of regulatory and contractual compliance requirements relevant to enterprise SaaS/security vendors.

• Detailed oriented

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.
The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.

What you'll do
As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.

Responsibilities

• Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.

• Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.

• Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.

• Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.

• Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.

• Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.

• Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.

• Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.

• Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.

• Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.

You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.
Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.

• Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.

• Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.

• Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.

• Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.

• Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.

Preferred qualifications

• Deep knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.

• Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.

• Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.

• Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.

• Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.

jobs.title: Americas Field Enablement Director
jobs.description:
As the Americas Field Enablement Director, you hold a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. Rubrik is growing quickly, and the field needs a leader who can connect global corporate strategy with the realities of selling across the different markets, buying journeys and levels of maturity.
You will own the readiness and productivity of the Americas sales organization. You’ll assist architecting and scaling enablement programs, from onboarding for new hires through to advanced value selling for tenured/ramped sellers. The goal is that every Account Executive can clearly communicate Rubrik’s Zero Trust Data Security and AI-driven resilience story to the organizations, from hospitals to governments to financial institutions, that rely on us to keep operating.
You’ll work directly with the GVP of America and regional sales leaders, with the backing of the Global Enablement team and the autonomy to build and drive what your theater needs. What you build will show up in ramp time, win rates and quota attainment.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Executive Partnership

• Executive Partnership: Act as the primary strategic partner to the GVP of America, AVPs/RVPs and Regional Directors, tying enablement priorities and KPIs directly to regional revenue targets.

• Regional Strategy & Roadmap: Build and own the Americas enablement roadmap, aligned to Global Enablement programs and shaped by leadership input, metrics and needs analysis, so investment goes where the biggest gaps are.

• Gap Analysis: Run regular assessments of the sales team’s skills and performance to identify readiness gaps early, and close them before they show up in the forecast.

• Front-Line Coaching: Act as a multiplier for sales reps and sales leaders by coaching deal progression and deal reviews.

Program Development & Delivery

• Program Development & Delivery: Design and deliver enablement in region for both ramping and ramped sellers, from foundational onboarding to advanced value selling.

• Onboarding: Reinforce and extend the global onboarding journey in Americas, track ramp progress and validate capstones, so new hires reach productivity faster.

• Methodology Mastery: Drive adoption of Rubrik’s sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) so pipeline qualification and deal execution are consistent across every region and segment.

Metrics & Operational Excellence

• Data-Driven Insights: Track, analyze and report on the impact of enablement programs using CRM (Salesforce, Tableau) and sales engagement tools (Clari).

• KPI Ownership: Measure success through quota attainment, win rates, conversion rates and the adoption of new processes- reporting on the success quarterly.

Qualifications & Experience

• Experience: 10+ years in Sales Enablement, a Sales role and/or Sales Leadership within a high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity environment.

• Leadership: 5 years leading sales teams, with a proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

• Program Design: A track record of building and scaling enablement programs, from onboarding through advanced selling, that measurably improved sales performance.

• Methodology: Hands-on experience driving adoption of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message.

• Market Knowledge: A deep understanding of the Americas sales landscape, regional business practices and the competitive cybersecurity market.

• Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce and AI-forward CMS/LMS platforms. Experience with AI-assisted coaching tools is a significant advantage.

Who You Are (Preferred Qualifications)

• Strategic Architect: You don’t just deliver training; you build the systems and frameworks that drive predictable revenue and long-term growth.

• Exceptional Communicator: You have strong executive presence and can act as the trusted “voice of truth” when presenting to senior leadership.

• Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive where the product landscape evolves monthly, and you treat continuous learning as part of the job.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Intern
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do
As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.
Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

• Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.

• Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.

• Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions

• Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.

• Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

• Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

• Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

• Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

• A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline.

• Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

• Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.

• Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

• At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.

• One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.

• Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.

• Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.

• Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Billing
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll do
You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.
The team is looking for a Revenue and Finance Automation specialist with a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process and how modern businesses manage subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the billing infrastructure space, helping them design solutions on Stripe Billing that reduce churn, improve cash collection, and align their financial operations with accurate revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS standards.

Responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Billing, Invoicing, and Revenue Recognition products to accelerate opportunities

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process—including subscription and usage-based billing, dunning, proration, and revenue recognition workflows—and how these map to Stripe's platform

• Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing billing architecture and business model to architect solutions that align Stripe's capabilities with their quote-to-cash requirements

• Advise customers on how to design for complexity: mid-cycle upgrades, entitlement management, multi-currency revenue recognition, and integration with ERP systems (NetSuite, Workday, SAP)

• Create and share best practices and reusable assets such as reference architectures to enhance the quality and efficiency of the broader sales and pre-sales organizations

• Partner closely with the Billing product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" to drive product and feature request prioritization

• Identify product, industry, implementation, and competitive trends, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales to influence Stripe's billing product roadmap

• Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team

• Represent the technical health of the business on quarterly sales forecast calls and highlight deal blockers with proposed solutions

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on billing, subscription, or revenue management platforms

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with the order-to-cash process in a SaaS environment, including subscription lifecycle management, dunning, and revenue recognition

• Strong understanding of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606, IFRS 15) and how they apply to SaaS and usage-based business models

• Experience working with or implementing billing and ERP software (NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Zuora, BillingPlatform, or similar)

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

• Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications

• Familiarity with complex billing scenarios: usage-based pricing, tiered models, multi-entity revenue recognition, or hybrid subscription and consumption models

• Experience with CRM platforms and their integration with billing systems

• Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
job.description:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technology?
Does building next generation Cloud Computing technology excites you?

Join our Compute Site Reliability team!
Our team is responsible for monitoring and measuring the reliability of our suite of Compute products and platform. In collaboration with Engineering and Product teams, we focus on improving the performance and reliability of the products we support.

Partner with the best
Apply statistical analysis and networking expertise to solve critical cloud delivery challenges. Independently maintain our massive compute fleet using system diagnostics and best practices. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to benchmark performance and drive reliability improvements.
As a Site Reliability Engineer II, you will be responsible for:

• Troubleshooting Linux networking and cloud infrastructure performance issues.

• Implementing monitoring, alerts, and SLOs using Prometheus and Grafana.

• Responding to incidents, escalating risks, and supporting root cause analysis.

• Developing automation, software tools, and infrastructure-as-code to improve reliability.

• Analyzing system metrics to improve compute fleet health and capacity.

• Partnering across teams on product goals, operations, and documentation.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 3+ years of academic or industry experience and a relevant bachelor's degree

• Have SRE or systems engineering experience with large-scale distributed systems

• Understand Linux networking, DNS, routing, and L7 proxies (Envoy, HAProxy, NGINX)

• Have experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK

• Be proficient in scripting and infrastructure automation tools (Python, Terraform, Ansible)

• Be familiar with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools

About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA
URL: https://we.are.expensify.com/

Your Mission, Should You Choose To Accept
Join our passionate team of customer experts to solve real-world problems and help people spend less time managing expenses and more time pursuing their real goals. As we revolutionize the way people manage their expenses, being part of the Expensify team means building the easiest, fastest, and most efficient platform to automate everything expense-related.

Customer Success Management at Expensify
Own a portfolio of our mid-market and enterprise customers, from onboarding through renewal and growth. You'll be the person enterprise customers trust to keep things running, and to spot the next opportunity before they've even asked. If you like turning usage data into revenue outcomes and holding your own in a C-suite conversation, this one's for you.

As a Customer Success Manager, your responsibilities include:

• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across finance, IT and operations, right up to the C-suite

• Owning the full account lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, renewal and growth

• Spotting risk and configuration issues early, and proactively solving them

• Guiding customers through migrations and product rollouts, instilling confidence in the product and your ability to support them in any software transition within their tech stack

• Turning usage data into a clear account plan that ties activity back to revenue

• Driving adoption of Expensify's core products, including expense management, global reimbursement, Expensify Card and Travel

• Troubleshooting technical issues hands-on, from accounting integrations and card feeds to SSO and API workflows, and tracing each one to its root cause

• Acting as the bridge between customers and our product and engineering teams, translating customer feedback into something they can act on

• Managing renewals, upsell and cross-sell conversations, and holding your own in contract talks

You'll be expected to:

• Improve net dollar retention across your portfolio

• Engage with your accounts every quarter

• Forecast and increase contract renewals

• Increase product adoption across your accounts

About You
We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who thinks like a product manager and acts like a trusted advisor. You've owned renewals, run QBRs and grown accounts through cross-sell and upsell. You understand how software works, and financial systems knowledge is a bonus. You're comfortable with data, not vibes, and you build account plans that tie activity back to revenue. You use AI to work smarter, but you never let it replace your own judgment. You see a problem and want to fix it, even when it isn't technically yours to fix.

Experience and Background
Required

• 3+ years of B2B SaaS account management or customer success experience, with direct ownership of a customer portfolio

• Experience owning renewals, retention, and growth, including commercial conversations around pricing, expansion, or contract terms

• Strong product and technical fluency, with experience working through APIs, integrations, or other connected software systems

• Strong data literacy, including using spreadsheets, dashboards, usage data, and reporting tools to make decisions and build a business case

• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders

• Comfort operating autonomously, setting priorities and managing competing demands without heavy day-to-day direction

Desirable

• Experience managing enterprise accounts, or a mix of mid-market and enterprise

• Experience with FinTech, payments, spend management, accounting, ERP, or other financial software

• Familiarity with tools and integrations such as NetSuite, Okta, Workday, HubSpot, GitHub, Gong, or similar platforms

• Experience using AI to automate workflows, improve processes, or solve business problems

• Experience managing global customers and working effectively across time zones and asynchronously

Compensation & Benefits:

• 401(k) with up to 4.5% employer match

• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage

• $20,000 annual fertility and family-building benefit through Carrot

• Up to $5,000 in relocation reimbursement if you move to one of our offices

• Three months of paid parental leave; six months for birthing parents

• Commuter, healthcare FSA, and dependent care FSA benefits

• Flexible vacation policy

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/expensify-customer-success-manager
